project_naming.policy: LBW and YBW are names/identifiers, not combustion-mode labels. Never infer physical meaning from the repository name.

teacher_direction.primary_instruction: Build the one-dimensional ramjet/scramjet model first using the teacher-provided CFD formulas and Cao Ruifeng references; the teacher described this as a second, more accurate scheme.
teacher_direction.target_model_family: unsteady quasi-one-dimensional conservative CFD model for a dual-mode/scramjet combustor
primary_reference_set: Teacher-provided photographed Chapter 11: 双模态冲压燃烧室一维数值模拟
曹瑞峰：面向控制的超燃冲压发动机一维建模研究
曹瑞峰：超燃冲压发动机燃烧模态转换及其控制方法研究

cfl_time_step.note: Teacher reference shows a one-half acoustic/convective cap; project exposes a general CFL control and already defaults cfl=0.5.

teacher_relative_density_convergence_met.policy: Retain the existing normalized steady residual; do not weaken convergence to density change alone.

near_sonic_eigenvalue_smoothing.note: Current Steger-Warming uses raw lambda +/- |lambda| splitting. Do not guess epsilon.

temperature_and_composition_dependent_th.reference: Teacher Chapter 11 Eqs. 11.30-11.35 and Cao references
temperature_and_composition_dependent_th.note: Production gas model is calorically perfect with constant gamma/R.

chemical_energy_bookkeeping_consistency.note: External wall/additional heat is distinct from reaction chemical energy. Direct Qdot remains a surrogate; future composition-enthalpy chemistry must not double-count energy.
